# staterepo

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments/pkg/secrets/git/staterepo"
```

Package staterepo reconciles the Package state\-repository clone secret — the same ExternalSecret lifecycle as the Build/Deployment variants \(pkg/secrets/git/build, pkg/secrets/git/deployment\), scoped to a Package's declared state repository. Named staterepo rather than package: "package" is a reserved Go keyword.

## type PackageStateRepositorySecretReconciler

PackageStateRepositorySecretReconciler converges the ExternalSecret used to clone a Package's declared state repository — the same lifecycle as BuildGitSSHSecretReconciler, scoped to Package.

```go

    Client    client.Client
    Log       logr.Logger
    StoreName string
    StoreKind string
}
```
